fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Register the rlm tool for querying oversized inputs.

fields.label: Max root turns
fields.description: Exploration turns before the model must answer from what it found. A run never exceeds 30: the tool's own max_iterations parameter is capped there, and the smaller of the two wins.

fields.label: Sub-call budget
fields.description: Recursive llm_query calls allowed per run. A run's cost is dominated by these. 0 disables them, leaving the root model to work with code alone.
